channel.title: The Steve Wilkos Show
channel.desc: Steve looks back at some of the most ridiculous, unbelievable and flat-out wild excuses guests have tried to pass off on his stage; from head-scratching stories to excuses that defy all logic, this special episode shines a spotlight on the moments that left Steve and all of us wondering, "Did they really just say that?" Don't miss this unforgettable recap of the wildest, most outrageous lies ever told on "The Steve Wilkos Show," today!
